ValidationRule.description: Prevents moving a Quote out of 'Quote Accepted' status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Status) && ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status), 'Quote Accepted')&& NOT ( ISPICKVAL (Status, 'Quote Accepted') ) && NOT (ISCHANGED (SkipValidations__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: An accepted quote cannot be reverted!
